name: Compare and choose
summary: Put a few options side by side on the same attributes, mark what is better, recommend when there's a clear fit, and let the user choose.
whenToUse: Choosing between 2–4 plans, products, routes or offers
whenNotToUse: More than ~5 options: filter-and-browse or a sortable Table
structure: Comparison with attributes in the same order for every option
Optional recommendation with a one-line reason

checks.description: A one-line summary helps the decision

journey.goal: Pick the option that fits best
checkpoints: All options are compared on the same attributes
journey.done: The choose event is sent with the selected option

agent: Read each option's attributes (column headers name them), pick by the user's criteria, then activate that option's choose action.
